notes.content: I'm the creator of Bad Trip. Join me as I play the demo!

notes.title: The Demo is LIVE! Try Bad Trip Now
notes.content:
Hey everyone, my name is Pedro Hertz. I'm the creator of Bad Trip.

I'm happy to announce that the Bad Trip demo is now available to play! I've been working tirelessly over the past few weeks to get it ready in time for Steam Next Fest. Huge shoutout to TheBossa Works for his help during the process!

If you enjoy surreal horror experiences that rely on atmosphere, sound, and pure instinct for survival—this might be for you.

I’d love to hear your thoughts. Whether it’s feedback, critiques, or bug reports, your input will help shape the game as it develops. Feel free to share your experience.

-Pedro
